column1: # Optional post-Venus Ash Jenna conversation, with no Lamakan choice.

column3: You made it back.\nNot everyone did,\nI take it.{end_wait}
{actor_name:7} fell from\nVenus Lighthouse.\n{actor_name:5} jumped after her.{end_wait}
And you couldn't\nsave either one.\nThat must hurt.{end_wait}
We're going to look.\nWe don't know what\nhappened below.{end_wait}
You'd search the sea\nwithout knowing\nif they're alive?{end_wait}
They deserve a chance.\nWe won't leave them\nwithout trying.{end_wait}

Those soldiers at Suhalla.
I burned their medicine.{page_break}I wanted them to know
what it was like to wait
for help that never came.{end_wait}
They were wounded.\nWhat did that prove?{end_wait}
In my world, the beacons\nburned. Then it was gone.{page_break}I watched people die.\nThe Wise One did nothing.{end_wait}
And you think hurting\nthem will bring it back?{end_wait}
No. Nothing will.{page_break}But why should your world\nbe spared what mine\nhad to endure?{end_wait}
These people had\nnothing to do with\nyour world.{end_wait}
Your {actor_name:6} and Kraden\nare still out there.\nGo find them, then.{end_wait}
And Felix and Sheba.\nWe haven't forgotten\nthem either.{end_wait}

The Venus beacon is lit.
You saw what happened.{page_break}Do you still believe
the Wise One will
save you?{end_wait}
I'll ask for answers.\nBut I won't make others\npay for what I lose.{end_wait}
Then go find him, Isaac.\nAsk the Wise One why\nmy world had to die.{end_wait}
I'll find my friends.\nAnd I'll stop you if\nyou hurt anyone else.{end_wait}
